Evening chai tastes even better with something crispy, crunchy and delicious! In this video, discover 4 easy and flavourful evening snack recipes by Chef Sanjeev Kapoor that are perfect for satisfying your cravings and making tea time extra special.
Here's what we're making:
Peri Peri Makhana – Crunchy roasted lotus seeds tossed in a homemade peri peri spice mix for a spicy and flavourful snack.
Murukku – A traditional South Indian snack made with rice flour and gram flour, seasoned with cumin and asafoetida, and fried until golden and crispy.
